LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_GroupByAmmoTypeTip: Combine colonists who can use the same ammo type into one row, edited for all of them at once - instead of one section per colonist.
LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_SubSingle: {0} - what they carry. Editing this fully replaces their weapon's default ammo - takes effect the next time they check their gear.
LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_SubMulti: {0} colonists selected - what each carries. Editing fully replaces the default ammo of each weapon.
LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_ClearAllTipSingle: Remove every ammo type - {0} will carry no ammo at all, not even their weapon's default.
LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_ClearAllTipMulti: Remove every ammo type from all {0} selected colonists - none of them will carry any ammo, not even their weapon's default.
LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_CopyTip: Copies this colonist's ammo choice. Paste it onto others with the paste column in Equip Colonists.
LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_ResetTip: Revert every selected colonist's ammo back to what it was when this window was opened.
LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_AnyAmmoGroupedTip: Let the game auto-pick the best researched ammo for {0} - this is what the Supply popup and production checks already use while no specific type is set. Click to revert every applicable colonist back to this.\n\nApplies to: {1}
LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_AnyAmmoRowTip: Let the game auto-pick the best researched ammo for {0} - this is what the Supply popup and production checks already use while no specific type is set below. Click to revert back to this after picking a specific type.
LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_ClickOpenBillsTab: Click to open its Bills tab.
LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_ClickOpenSupplyPopup: Click to open the Supply popup and queue production for it.
LanguageData.CER_ChangeAmmo_NoneWeaponsTakeAmmo: None of the selected colonists' weapons take ammo.
